368211.custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders and click the All tab.
  2. Tap Search and type "zz-no-such-work-order".
  3. Read the message shown in the list area below the search box.
  4. Tap Clear filters (if there is no Clear filters action, tap the clear icon ⊗ in the search box and write that in the result).

368215.custom_steps:
1. Click Parts in the top menu, then Part Sales.
  2. Click the [PS-1] row in the Part Sales list to open it.
  3. Read the status card at the left of the page.

368216.custom_steps:
1. Click Parts in the top menu, then Part Sales.
  2. Click the [PS-1] row in the Part Sales list to open it.
  3. On the status card pick a different person in the technician field (on part sales it may read Sales Representative), e.g. [Tech-A]. If the card has no technician or Sales Representative field, write the fields you see.
  4. Reload the page and read the field.

368245.custom_steps:
1. Click Customers in the top menu.
  2. Read the first page of rows.
  3. Click the Customer Name column header.
  4. Read the order of the rows in the Customer Name column.
  5. Go to the next page: scroll to the bottom of the table so the next rows load.
